text: Two views, one solid. In Solid Light, your pinch shapes the cyan outline. Luma chooses the amber depth. Together, you build a route this little traveler can actually cross.
I'll pinch and hold, loop around this short ribbon, then release. My line becomes one silhouette. Luma now tries depth profiles against the actual construction.
We haven't reached the far bank. Luma can change depth, but can't add the missing length. That amber section is asking for my help.
I'll extend my outline through the gap. Same hand, same simple gesture. Luma keeps its own perspective and tests the new intersection.
There's the route. Our traveler crosses only after the solid passes. My outline and Luma's tested depth stay here beside what we made.
That hand-off is the heart of co-creation. Captured in the official Immersive Web SDK emulator with hand input. Physical-device performance and usability testing are still pending.
